name: controlloop
description: Review what a change lets your AI agents do. Runs the open-source ControlLoop CLI locally against the default branch and explains its verdict, the authority each change grants, and each finding with its documentation link. Read-only; no hooks.

interface.shortDescription: Review what a change lets your AI agents do
interface.longDescription: Ask Codex what a branch lets your AI agents do. ControlLoop runs the open-source ControlLoop CLI on your machine against the default branch and explains its verdict, the authority each change adds (MCP servers, auto-approvals, hooks, sandbox and approval settings, agent workflows), and each finding with a link to its rule documentation. It is read-only: it never edits your configuration and installs nothing without asking.
defaultPrompt: What does this branch let my agents do?
Did this change give any agent new permissions?
Explain the ControlLoop findings on this branch.
